evidence.ACL: Grade 1 injury of ACL and PCL.
evidence.MCL: Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration.
evidence.Medial OA: Osteoarthritis of right knee joint, more severe at lateral compartment.
evidence.Lateral OA: Osteoarthritis of right knee joint, more severe at lateral compartment.
evidence.Contusion: Wearing of articular cartilage and subchondral bone marrow edeama, especially at lateral aspect of knee joint; large spur formation.
